user.title: HA Dispatch Client Setup
user.description: Connect your Home Assistant instance to HA Dispatch server

data_description.server_url: Base URL of the HA Dispatch server, e.g. https://dispatch.example.com
data_description.registration_secret: Required by internet-facing servers. Leave blank if the server has no enrolment secret configured.

error.invalid_registration_secret: The server rejected the registration secret. Check the value and try again.

send_test_metrics.name: Send test metrics
send_test_metrics.description: Send test metrics to verify server connectivity and metric submission.

trigger_alert.name: Trigger alert
trigger_alert.description: Quick test to trigger predefined alerts on the server (disk_low, cpu_high, memory_high, or all).

force_update.name: Force update
force_update.description: Force an immediate status update and metric submission instead of waiting for the next scheduled update.

send_custom_metric.name: Send custom metric
send_custom_metric.description: Send custom metric values for advanced testing.

submit_alert.name: Submit alert
submit_alert.description: Submit a structured alert to the HA Dispatch server with full control over all fields.

context.name: Context
context.description: Additional context data as JSON object (optional)

resolve_alert.name: Resolve alert
resolve_alert.description: Resolve all unresolved alerts of a specific type for this installation.

install_update.name: Install client update
install_update.description: Install the client release the HA Dispatch server is currently offering. The archive is verified against a pinned signing key before anything is replaced, and Home Assistant restarts afterwards to load it.

force.name: Force
force.description: Install even when the offered version is not newer than the installed one. Allows reinstalling or downgrading; leave off unless you mean it.
